minimum_schema.contractVersion: u32 = 1, on an explicit PRODUCTION_RESULT_V1 route
minimum_schema.status: u32 success/failure code preserving exact stage failure information
minimum_schema.top3: capacity 3; each {classIndex:u32, scoreBits:u32}; unused failed slots zeroed and not published as classifications

session_descriptor.identity_change_rule: New descriptor and new owner session required; never change class mapping/model inside a bound session.

production_result_schema.input_admission: Ordinary V1 uses the accepted validated resident-input route. Bind and capture its receipt token on admission before any stage execution. The qualified uploaded-waveform performance route is the current authority. Other resident producers require their own separately accepted acquisition/input qualification; this contract does not newly accept live audio. Linked synthetic/wren fixtures remain diagnostic/legacy inputs. If no valid required input identity can be captured, reject admission instead of publishing a result with invented or absent input identity.
production_result_schema.input_producer_domain: Preserve the accepted H1WaveformProducer domain from the bound source; only a non-None producer with separately qualified input authority is admissible. Do not introduce an ad hoc fixture producer or accept a producer solely because an enum value exists.

status_domain.8: Profile failure: diagnostic only, not a product profile prerequisite

production_result_schema.status_validity_invariants: Completed success is status=1, valid=1, topCount=3. Completed failure uses a precise non-success stage status, valid=0, topCount=0, and the admitted input/result tokens. status=0 is uninitialized/no result and cannot be a completed publication. Missing/invalid identity or unavailable service before admission is a request rejection. A profile diagnostic cannot block ordinary product completion.

ordering.score_arithmetic: logit = float(int16_logit) * floatFromBits(0x3a08d017); score = 1.0f / (1.0f + expf(-logit)), using exactly the accepted FP32 expression/toolchain behavior.
ordering.finite_requirement: All 11560 generated scores must be finite before success; no partial or non-finite result.
ordering.ties: Numerically equal exact FP32 score values use lower zero-based class index first. Preserve original score bits, including any equal-value bit representation.
ordering.prefix_requirement: For identical accepted score bits, top3 equals entries 0..2 of the accepted top100 result in both indices and score bits.
ordering.threshold_semantics: No implicit threshold filtering, score rescaling or renormalization; top3 always reports the three highest finite accepted scores.

production_result_schema.PRODUCTION_RESULT_READY: The admitted inference has completed all product-required arithmetic, all-score finite validity, accepted input/model/ownership/cache/guard checks, exact sorted top3 and metadata, and a stable self-contained compact result snapshot is completely published with its token. All PRODUCT_REQUIRED fields and selected optional fields are final before this event. Diagnostic evidence is not a prerequisite. No product-required computation/publication/save may occur after Ready.
production_result_schema.failed_completion: Publish precise status with valid=0, topCount=0 and the admitted generation identity; never emit successful PRODUCTION_RESULT_READY for failure or relabel the last good result as this run. Rejected admission is a separate request error, not a completed inference.
production_result_schema.retention: Retain one compact completed result independently of mutable inference workspaces until explicit retirement or next atomic complete publication. Staging and read/publication synchronization may use a second small slot; no full-score or full-boundary snapshot permitted for ordinary result retention.
production_result_schema.internal_workspace_and_safety: Generating all exact scores, frontend output validation, quantization, guard checks, model initialization identity and ownership/cache coherency remain required. Only product result/evidence retention semantics change prospectively.

generation.INFERENCE_GENERATION_ID: A fresh token allocated when inference is admitted: {result_owner_session, epoch:u64, inferenceSequence:u64}. Sequence advances for each admitted run, including failure; input generation reuse does not reuse inference token.
generation.RESULT_GENERATION_ID: The same admitted token copied/published with completion; valid only in its issuing result owner session.
generation.BOUNDARY_BUFFER_GENERATION_ID: Per-source {owner_session, epoch, inferenceSequence, state}; INVALID before any write, WRITING during writes, COMPLETE only after the entire relevant stage and ownership/cache checks succeed.
generation.EVIDENCE_GENERATION_ID: Explicit diagnostic transaction token equal to its inference/result token; COMPLETE only when every required diagnostic field and source is coherent.
generation.input_generation_is_distinct: Waveform epoch/generation/producer receipt captured on admission; many distinct inference generations may use the same validated waveform generation.
generation.owner_session_scope: IDs are not globally persistent boot UUIDs. Reset/reinitialization terminates the issuing owner session, clears result/evidence state and pins, and requires a fresh session binding. Never import/restore an old-session token, even if numeric epoch/sequence values repeat after cold boot.
generation.epoch_and_sequence_exhaustion: Fail closed before wrap; no reset to zero inside a live owner session.
generation.existing_waveform_lifecycle: Keep accepted mutation admission, validation, leases, receipt CRC and declared SHA semantics unchanged. Do not infer new output-buffer generation protection from the existing input-only lease.
generation.binding_required_for_each_evidence_sourc: requested inference generation == result generation == source-buffer generation == evidence generation, including owner_session and epoch, for every buffer read.
generation.reader_writer_rule: One serialized diagnostic owner; reject all source-buffer writer admission while its read/export pin is active. Check token, COMPLETE state and pin before every chunk and before final evidence completion; invalidate before releasing to a writer.
generation.diagnostic_release: Explicit release/cancel or defined bounded timeout retires evidence before any next writer. In-progress transfer cannot succeed after retirement; a multi-chunk result needs one coherent completion token.
generation.old_production_result_evidence_request: Reject EVIDENCE_NOT_RETAINED; never scan lingering bytes, silently rerun under the old token, or synthesize a diagnostic result for that production generation.
generation.comparison_between_generations: Numerical repeat comparison is allowed between independently completed/bound diagnostic generations; bind each side separately and preserve accepted comparison predicate.

production_result_schema.wire_command_numbers_and_Cpp_ABI: Not implemented or assigned by this freeze. Future design must use an explicit production contract route and prove logical fields/widths; no silent diagnostic protocol reinterpretation.
